jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.summary: This hands on role is the technical owner of information security for cloud infrastructure and internal systems ensuring technical controls are implemented operated and tested. The role focuses on improving monitoring driving vulnerability remediation automating security operations and providing reliable audit evidence to reduce risk and maintain compliance.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu About Semaphore Semaphore is a remote-first software company helping engineering teams build, test, and deliver software with confidence. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to run critical development workflows securely and reliably. We maintain SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001:2022 compliance and are hiring a Security Engineer to own the technical side of our security program. About the role You will be the technical owner of information security across our infrastructure and internal systems. You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, and our Compliance Manager to turn security and compliance requirements into practical, reliable controls. This is a hands-on role. You will investigate vulnerabilities, operate security monitoring, improve infrastructure and access controls, automate recurring work, and lead technical remediation. Our Compliance Manager owns the ISMS, policies, audit coordination, and legal or regulatory interpretation; you will own the implementation, operation, and testing of the technical controls behind them. We care more about demonstrated ownership and sound judgment than a specific number of years or a previous job title. What you will own Run the vulnerability-management lifecycle: scanning, triage, prioritization, remediation, exceptions, and verification. Operate and improve security monitoring and SIEM tooling, including alert quality, dashboards, detection rules, and integrations. Investigate security alerts and lead the technical response to security incidents. Improve the security of Linux hosts, cloud infrastructure, networks, firewalls, containers, and internal services. Own technical controls for identity and access management, least privilege, just-in-time access, secrets, and certificates. Automate patching, evidence collection, recurring control checks, and other security operations. Coordinate penetration tests and drive technical findings through remediation and verification. Translate SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control requirements into effective technical implementations. Produce clear technical evidence for internal and external audits in partnership with the Compliance Manager. Maintain security runbooks, system documentation, risk-based priorities, and operational metrics. Help engineering teams make practical security decisions without adding unnecessary process. Reference: 60UjvO9e-eBJ2TxayPLbvZszIGksZqS_5w3328CSmDQl5O2x-ZrKWBgtW-YglfmG What we are looking for Proven ownership of technical security in a production SaaS, cloud, hosting, or infrastructure environment. Strong Linux systems, networking, and cloud-security fundamentals. Hands-on experience with vulnerability management, patching, hardening, and remediation at scale. Experience operating SIEM or security-monitoring systems and investigating security events. Practical understanding of IAM, privileged access, secrets management, certificates, and network controls. Ability to automate operational work using Python, Bash, infrastructure-as-code, or similar tools. Experience participating in incident response and communicating clearly during high-pressure situations. Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security-control frameworks. Strong written and spoken English and comfort working independently in a remote, asynchronous team. jobs.title: Senior Flutter Mobile Developer
jobs.summary: Senior Flutter developer vodi migraciju postojećih iOS i Android aplikacija na Flutter uz očuvanje funkcionalnosti i stabilnosti. Kandidat će doprinositi razvoju novih funkcionalnosti, rešavanju produkcionih problema i donošenju tehničkih odluka.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Tražimo iskusnog Senior Flutter Mobile Developera koji će se pridružiti našem timu i učestvovati u migraciji postojećih mobilnih aplikacija na Flutter tehnologiju, kao i u njihovom daljem razvoju i održavanju. Trenutno imamo više mobilnih aplikacija razvijenih u nativnim tehnologijama — iOS aplikacije u Swiftu, a Android aplikacije u Kotlinu. Naš cilj je da ih postepeno migriramo na Flutter, uz očuvanje postojećih funkcionalnosti, kvaliteta i stabilnosti, kao i mogućnost daljeg unapređenja proizvoda. Tražimo osobu koja ima napredno poznavanje Fluttera, iskustvo u razvoju produkcionih mobilnih aplikacija i sposobnost da samostalno donosi tehničke odluke, planira implementaciju i sarađuje sa ostatkom razvojnog tima. Ključne odgovornosti: Migracija postojećih iOS aplikacija razvijenih u Swiftu i Android aplikacija razvijenih u Kotlinu na Flutter. Analiza postojećih aplikacija, njihove arhitekture i funkcionalnosti pre početka migracije. Planiranje i sprovođenje migracije uz očuvanje postojećeg korisničkog iskustva i poslovne logike. Razvoj novih funkcionalnosti i unapređenje postojećih mobilnih aplikacija. Održavanje, optimizacija performansi i rešavanje tehničkih problema u produkcionim aplikacijama. Integracija mobilnih aplikacija sa backend servisima putem REST API-ja i drugih odgovarajućih interfejsa. Implementacija nativnih funkcionalnosti iOS-a i Androida kada je to potrebno, uključujući povezivanje Fluttera sa postojećim nativnim kodom. Pisanje kvalitetnog, čitljivog i održivog koda, uz primenu odgovarajućih arhitektonskih obrazaca i principa dobre razvojne prakse. Pisanje i održavanje testova, otklanjanje grešaka i učešće u procesu objavljivanja aplikacija. Saradnja sa backend, frontend, QA i drugim članovima tima u planiranju i realizaciji razvojnih zadataka. Reference: 2EhXzqRW1YUqelQySGtf6WE83gdYhcl6-RLhzInghmCvTVjvPwAH0qmetCctFWex Obavezni uslovi: Minimum 3 godine profesionalnog iskustva u razvoju mobilnih aplikacija. Napredno, odnosno senior-level poznavanje Fluttera i programskog jezika Dart. Iskustvo u razvoju, objavljivanju i održavanju mobilnih aplikacija koje se koriste u produkciji. Dobro razumevanje arhitekture mobilnih aplikacija, upravljanja stanjem, asinhronog programiranja i životnog ciklusa aplikacija. Iskustvo u integraciji aplikacija sa REST API servisima i radu sa JSON podacima. Razumevanje razlika između iOS i Android platformi i njihovih specifičnosti. Sposobnost samostalnog rešavanja tehničkih problema i preuzimanja odgovornosti za kvalitet isporučenog rešenja. Spremnost za timski rad, razmenu znanja i saradnju sa kolegama iz različitih razvojnih oblasti. Prednost imaju kandidati koji poseduju iskustvo u migraciji nativnih iOS i Android aplikacija na Flutter. Praktično iskustvo sa Swiftom i Kotlinom, posebno u kontekstu povezivanja Fluttera sa nativnim kodom. Iskustvo sa Flutter platform channels, odnosno komunikacijom između Flutter i nativnih modula. Poznavanje arhitektonskih obrazaca kao što su Clean Architecture, MVVM ili slični pristupi. Iskustvo sa alatima za upravljanje stanjem, kao što su BLoC, Riverpod ili Provider. Iskustvo sa automatizovanim testiranjem, CI/CD procesima i automatizacijom izgradnje i objavljivanja aplikacija. Iskustvo sa objavljivanjem i održavanjem aplikacija na Google Play i Apple App Store platformama. Poznavanje Git-a i rada kroz code review procese. jobs.details: Game Designer Game Designer Elite Diplomatic d.o.o. Odgovara na prijave Beograd Beograd: Jurija Gagarina 76 14.11.2026. 3D junior Hey we’re looking for a Game Designer (Belgrade). We’re a small indie studio in Belgrade, and we’re building an old-school first-person shooter fast, weighty gunplay, the kind of movement and punch you remember from the immersive sims of the late 90s/early 2000s, but rebuilt with a look that’s our own. There’s a real story underneath it too: a grim, dystopian sciencepunk world where the choices you make actually change how things play out. It’s still unannounced, it’s aiming at AA scope, and we want an eager, capable Game Designer to actually design the thing. You’d be shaping systems that end up in players’ hands. What you’d be doing Designing and prototyping the core gameplay; Working closely with our Creative Director and Writer on the branching, choice-driven stuff; Teaming up with the 3D, Environment, and Tech folks to get levels standing up; Living in UE5 greyboxing, building, iterating until it feels right. What we’re hoping you bring A real want to learn and get better, and to take notes without taking them personally; Hands-on UE5 time (greyboxing and prototyping especially); A good feel for what makes shooters and story games click extra love if you’re into immersive sims; Some sense of how a game actually comes together start to finish; Nice to have, not required: something you’ve made a shipped game, a student project, a jam entry, anything that shows how your head works. What you’d get A fair salary for your experience, and we revisit it regularly raises included; A studio that means it about work-life balance; Someone in your corner to help you grow tell us where you want to go and we’ll help you get there.
